name: Ni WooCommerce Sales Report – Orders, Revenue & Sales Analytics Dashboard
author: Anzar Ahmed

sections.description:
Ni WooCommerce Sales Report is a free WooCommerce sales report and analytics plugin that turns your raw order data into clear, actionable reports. Track sales, orders, revenue, tax, shipping, discounts, refunds, top products, categories and customers – all from a single WooCommerce reports dashboard inside your WordPress admin.

Whether you run a small shop or a high-volume store, this WooCommerce order report plugin helps you answer the questions that matter: How much did I sell today? Which products sell best? Where do my customers come from? How many new vs. repeat customers do I have? Which payment gateway drives the most revenue?

Key features of this WooCommerce sales report plugin

  • Sales dashboard – total sales, this year / this month / this week / today / yesterday sales and order counts at a glance.
  • Order Product report – line-item level sales with filters for date range, order number, billing name and billing email, plus a printable view.
  • Summary Report – order count, order total, shipping, shipping tax, tax, cart discount, discount tax, sold product quantity, refund total, refund quantity, new customers and repeat customers for any period.
  • Order Status report – orders, revenue, tax, shipping and discount broken down by WooCommerce order status.
  • Category sales report – revenue by product category.
  • Top Product report – best sellers for today, yesterday and the last 7 days.
  • Monthly Sales report – month-by-month revenue and order count for the selected year.
  • Analytical Sales report – current year vs. previous year sales comparison.
  • Product Analysis report – per-product performance by year and by order status.
  • Dashboard widgets – recent orders, order status chart, payment gateway chart, top 5 customers, top 5 countries and stock alerts (low, out of stock, most stocked).
  • Flexible date filters – today, yesterday, last 7 / 10 / 15 / 30 / 60 days and this year.

WooCommerce HPOS compatible

Every report is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS / custom order tables) as well as the classic post-based order storage. Reports return the same figures no matter which storage mode your store uses, so you can enable HPOS with confidence.

Why choose Ni WooCommerce Sales Report

  • Free, lightweight and easy to use – no configuration required.
  • Optimised reporting queries built for speed on large stores.
  • Works alongside WooCommerce Analytics without conflicts.
  • Translation ready (English and Italian included).
  • Actively maintained and tested with the latest WordPress and WooCommerce.

Language support

  • English (Default)
  • Italiano/Italia

For more analytical report buy our pro version

Upgrade to the Pro version of the “Ni WooCommerce Sales Report” plugin and unlock even more powerful features to take your WooCommerce store to the next level:

Ni WooCommerce Sales Report Pro Version Feature

We have Ni WooCommerce Sales Report Pro that have more than 15+ reports and 20+ sales analytical count and amount.

  • Dashboard Sales Report Analysis (Order Count, Sales, Product Sold, Discount, Tax)
  • Sales Order Report, Filter By Date range, Order No, First Name and Order Status, Export,

  • Line chart show the daily sales amount on dashboard
  • Sold Product Sales Report

  • Order Status wise sales report

  • Country wise sales report

  • Filter all reports with date range, customer name, billing name, email address, order status and many more
  • Ability to filter and CSV/Excel export the sold product report

Support/Feedback Email/New Report Requirement

Users are fully responsible for their own use.
sections.installation:
1. Use the WordPress plugin installer or upload files to WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate “Ni WooCommerce Sales Report” plugin from admin panel.
  3. Admin Menu Name “Ni Sales Report”.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. Every report works with both HPOS / custom order tables and the classic post-based order storage, and returns the same figures in either mode.

Which sales reports are included?

Sales dashboard, Order Product report, Summary Report, Order Status report, Category report, Top Product report, Monthly Sales report, Analytical (year vs. year) report and Product Analysis report, plus dashboard widgets for recent orders, payment gateways, top customers, top countries and stock alerts.

Does it work with the latest WordPress and WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin is tested with the latest WordPress and WooCommerce releases and runs on PHP 7.4 through PHP 8.2.

Can I see today, this month or this year sales?

Yes. The dashboard shows today, yesterday, this week, this month and this year sales and order counts, and every report can be filtered by date range (today, yesterday, last 7 / 10 / 15 / 30 / 60 days, this year).

Will it slow down my store?

No. Reports use optimised database queries that run only when you open a report page, so there is no impact on your storefront.

Does it work with WooCommerce Analytics?

Yes. It runs alongside the built-in WooCommerce Analytics without any conflict.

Where can I get help?

Click on the support tab or email support@naziinfotech.com

Do you customize this plugin?

Yes, we can customize this plugin to match your requirements.
